devdoc.details: Source of truth for agent text records on this chain, read by an      off-chain CCIP-Read gateway via the ENS resolver shape (`text`, `addr`).      `avatar` and `addr` are derived from the agent's collection on read, so      they cannot drift.

AccessControlBadConfirmation().details: The caller of a function is not the expected one. NOTE: Don't confuse with {AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount}.

AlreadyProvisioned(address,uint256).details: `initAgentTexts` was called for an agent that is already provisioned.

DuplicateKey(string).details: The same key appears more than once in a batch of records.

MissingRequiredKey(string).details: A mandatory key would be left unset — either missing/empty in a      batch of records or cleared to empty on update.

NotAgentOwnerOrWallet(address,uint256,ad.details: Caller is neither the agent NFT owner nor a registered agent wallet.

NotProvisioned(address,uint256).details: `setAgentText` was called before the agent was initialized with `initAgentTexts`.

ReservedKey(string).details: Key is resolved by the registry itself (e.g. `avatar`) and cannot      be stored.

StringsInsufficientHexLength(uint256,uin.details: The `value` string doesn't fit in the specified `length`.

StringsInvalidAddressFormat().details: The string being parsed is not a properly formatted address.

UnknownCollection(address).details: Collection is not registered with the configured manager.

ZeroAddress(string).details: Error when an address parameter is the zero address.

AgentTextUpdated(address,uint256,string,.details: Emitted when an agent text record is written.

ManagerUpdated(address).details: Emitted when the collections manager address is updated by admin.

ParentNodeUpdated(bytes32).details: Emitted when the parent node is updated by admin.

RoleAdminChanged(bytes32,bytes32,bytes32.details: Emitted when `newAdminRole` is set as ``role``'s admin role, replacing `previousAdminRole` `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` is the starting admin for all roles, despite {RoleAdminChanged} not being emitted to signal this.

RoleGranted(bytes32,address,address).details: Emitted when `account` is granted `role`. `sender` is the account that originated the contract call. This account bears the admin role (for the granted role). Expected in cases where the role was granted using the internal {AccessControl-_grantRole}.

RoleRevoked(bytes32,address,address).details: Emitted when `account` is revoked `role`. `sender` is the account that originated the contract call:   - if using `revokeRole`, it is the admin role bearer   - if using `renounceRole`, it is the role bearer (i.e. `account`)

SubnodeProvisioned(address,uint256,bytes.details: Emitted when an agent subnode is first provisioned and bound to its NFT.

addr(bytes32).details: ENS `addr` shape. Derived on read from the agent's first registered      wallet; `address(0)` for unprovisioned nodes or agents with no wallet.

getRoleAdmin(bytes32).details: Returns the admin role that controls `role`. See {grantRole} and {revokeRole}. To change a role's admin, use {_setRoleAdmin}.

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Grants `role` to `account`. If `account` had not been already granted `role`, emits a {RoleGranted} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleGranted} event.

initAgentTexts(address,uint256,(string,s.details: Provision an agent's ENS subnode and seed its text records. Must run      before `setAgentText` and reverts if already provisioned. `records`      must include a non-empty `url`; the reserved `avatar` key is rejected      (derived on read from the collection's `default` image). Caller must      control the agent (NFT owner or registered wallet) and `collection`      must be manager-registered.

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). If the calling account had been revoked `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must be `callerConfirmation`. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from `account`. If `account` had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

setAgentText(address,uint256,string,stri.details: Update one text record on a provisioned subnode (reverts      `NotProvisioned` otherwise). Same caller/collection rules as      `initAgentTexts`; `key` may not be the reserved `avatar`.

setManager(address).details: Update the collections manager used to gate write access.

setParentNode(bytes32).details: Update the parent ENS node under which agent subnodes live.

text(bytes32,string).details: ENS `text` shape, so a gateway can read this registry directly.      Empty string for unset keys. `avatar` is derived on read from the      collection's `default` image as an ENSIP-12 URI (bare CIDs gain an      `ipfs://` prefix) and cannot be set via `setAgentText`.

agentRef.details: Reverse lookup from an agent subnode to its NFT; zero tuple for      unprovisioned nodes.

manager.details: The collections manager used to gate write access.

parentNode.details: The parent ENS node under which agent subnodes live (namehash of parent domain).

provisioned.details: Whether a given agent subnode has been provisioned through this registry.
